name: Pharaoh's Ward
disable: DC 27 Thievery check (master) to painstakingly remove the lintel without triggering the magic, or Dispel Magic (4th rank; counteract DC 25) to counteract the rune
reset: The trap resets when the door is shut.

items.name: Curse the Intruders
items.text:
Trigger The seal on the tomb is broken from the outside.

---

Effect Each living creature within 60 feet must succeed at a DC 23 Will save save or be subjected to the pharaoh's curse. A cursed creature takes a -2 status penalty to Fortitude saves, and any natural or magical healing it receives is halved. The curse remains until removed by Cleanse Affliction or similar magic.

text: A curse is imbued on an entryway's threshold.
